data.name: Swapnil Patil
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Swapnil Patil has made a big mark in cricket. With 5 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 47*, with an average of 86.50 and a quick strike rate of 205.95. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 14 sixes and 13 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 5.0 overs, taking 1 wickets at an economy rate of 18.80. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
